panel_description_zh: 近景平视，李斌把手机从耳边放下来；脸无表情；手中的筷子停了；肩膀仍塌。
prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level close-up of a 30-something East Asian Chinese man in the act of lowering the black smartphone in matte-black case away from his ear, the motion frozen at the moment the call has just ended. Face expressionless, eyes half-lidded looking down at nothing in particular, eyebrows flat, lips pressed together, dark circles under the eyes, clean-shaven jaw with no stubble, short black slightly messy side-swept hair. The hand holding the chopsticks has stopped mid-air, the noodles hanging limp. Shoulders still slumped. Wearing a loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt. Warm white living room light. Mood: the after-the-call quiet, the husband has just been issued the next order and is about to obey. Text watermark 'P10-PN05' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, smiling, wife visible in frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, romantic soft lighting, exaggerated cartoonish sweat drops, dramatic shadows
